answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond for one terrace work claim and buys one attestation from a distinct attester on the terrace ledger, an onyx signature binding claim and attester. A juniper auditor rechecks every attestation against the claimed work; a false claim or a reused attester burns both bonds. The first attestation costs 36; the k-th from one funder costs 36+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6030 and 1000 fakes pay 3,033,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-attester ring fails: one signature covers one claim. An honest agent claims once, pays 36 once, and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
